source_kind: settled handyman invoice in residential seller disclosure
payment_evidence: The issuer identifies as a handyman service. The final invoice records payment of its full total and a zero balance.
allocation: Two original invoice entries. Each has quantity one. Reported total equals both entries.
notes: No separate line for the picket, gate hardware or taxes. No painting labor described.

source_kind: firsthand family customer’s actual project spending breakdown
payment_evidence: The family member who hired the handyman describes finished door replacement, photographs installed doors and repaired ledges, and records spending by work category.
source_locator: New doors and exterior wood trim; Painting; Fixed Old Window Ledges; Final Cost Summary.

lines.name: Doors and trim, materials and installation
Replace and finish deteriorated window ledges

allocation: Sum of two expressly priced completed work categories in a wider project. These amounts are household project outlay and can include directly purchased materials; the source does not separate the handyman’s pay.
notes: Author reported three repaired windows in the narrative, while the caption shows five ledges in similar condition. Customer participation and bulk work on other tasks limit comparability to a standalone call. Other work from the renovation is excluded.

source_kind: homeowner interview with published completed project costs and before/after photographs
payment_evidence: The customer recounts the completed wall opening, construction and installation, and the published account itemizes actual costs for wall work, materials and installation.
source_locator: Kitchen makeover published August 2, 2022. Owner’s account following the description of the superintendent and handyman.

lines.name: New cabinetry, peninsula, countertop and overhead lights: materials
Install new cabinetry, peninsula, countertop and recessed lights

allocation: Sum of three separately reported project components. The article does not identify the payee for the materials or split the two workers’ earnings.
notes: The installers were a handyman and superintendent working together. The date is the report date, and direct contractor receipts were not published. Owner DIY cabinet painting, hardware and decorations are excluded.

source_kind: First-person homeowner project breakdown and photos
payment_evidence: The owner explicitly reports actual out-of-pocket materials and contract labor, distinct from replication costs and gifted materials. The linked project tour also states that the homeowner paid for the cabinets, lumber and handyman service out of pocket.

lines.name: Handyman labor including procurement and hauling

allocation: Paid construction subtotal: $1,141 materials plus $660 contract labor. Non-construction organizing accessories ($237) excluded. Previously held or gifted goods had no incremental purchase price.
notes: Completed by March 15, 2022 (project tour); prices posted April 28. Supplementary project/city evidence: https://www.lelaburris.com/allergen-safe-organized-pantry/ associates builder and project with Cleveland. Exact home municipality not specified; homeowner locates home just outside Chattanooga. Sponsor supported tools and certain hardware, not homeowner-paid components. No separate taxes reported.

source_kind: First-person homeowner renovation breakdown and photos
payment_evidence: The homeowner reports what she spent for a completed painting visit and a subsequent decor-mounting visit by the same handyman.

lines.name: Mirrors and hooks including purchase and mounting

allocation: Approximate total of two explicitly priced handyman scopes within a larger renovation. The first charge is approximate. The second is an installed component, not all labor.
notes: Report date July 11, 2018. Excludes work performed by other trades. No separate taxes reported. Location corroboration from the homeowner: https://sivanayla.com/2021/11/01/la-to-sd/ .

source_kind: Verified customer review and provider reply on Angi
payment_evidence: Customer says they purchased the materials and explicitly paid the handyman service for labor, and that the tradesperson worked until all three projects were completed. Provider confirms door and dryer vent scope.

lines.name: Two doors and other materials purchased by customer
Handyman labor including pickup, door installation and dryer vent

allocation: Total computed from approximate materials and exact labor. Service area is South Pittsburgh. Angi places the branch in Monongahela; exact job municipality not reported.
notes: Review month: November 2018. No independent receipt or separate tax line. No assumption about elapsed time.

source_kind: Customer and provider first-person statements on BBB
payment_evidence: The homeowner identifies the amount actually charged to their credit card for work completed on March 10. The provider confirms the material amount, billed hours, consultation credit and customer's acceptance of the work. Provider declined the requested refund.

lines.name: All remaining net service and labor charges after credit

allocation: Material line invoiced explicitly; net service and labor grouped as card total less materials; exact allocation among labor, trip/service and consultation credit unreported. Separate consultation, if previously paid, is outside this measured final invoice.
notes: The homeowner's retail price comparison is not evidence of individual billed material prices and is excluded. No separate taxes reported. Location from the service company’s Lakeland market, exact municipality unreported.
